title: drop swap
system_instruction_addendum: DROP SWAP ADDENDUM: A hard crossfader cut at the drop of deck b. Time it to the bar: early or late kills the drop.

tutor_speak.text: the drop swap is a hard cut, not a fade. you ride deck a into deck b's breakdown, then hit the crossfader on deck b's drop.
wait for the bar before deck b's drop. on beat one of the drop, throw the crossfader fully to deck b.

hints.text: the bar before the drop is your runway: get your hand on the crossfader.
the throw is one motion: no fade, no slide.
throw the crossfader from deck a to deck b in one move.
